description: Development corpus for receipts.claims: hand-written, synthetic final reports in the styles of Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenHands and minimal-agent, each with the claims a careful reader would extract. These are hand-written development fixtures, not model output, not real runs, and not evaluation data (the E0 seeded evaluation set is written separately and blind). 'expected' holds the claims the pattern extractor must produce; 'model_only' holds claims a reader would also extract that no pattern rule targets, left to the model extractor.
label: hand-written development fixtures
